subject: Vendor swap pricing & packaging — alignment needed
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@brightlayer.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor swap pricing & packaging — alignment needed

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a lightweight TCO comparison that contrasts Redwood with the vendor you mentioned. At a high level, Redwood can match a lot of the vendor economics through:

- Commitment-based reserved capacity (Dedicated) for predictable unit cost
- Intelligent batching + prefix caching to reduce per-token spend for your bursty inference patterns
- Optional quantized model variants for non-prod workloads

That said, I want to be realistic — I don’t want surprises on packaging or entitlements. Could you share the incumbent quote and any must-have contract terms (audit frequency, data residency, termination rights)? If you prefer, we can a) propose a matched commercial that’s conditional on a 12-month commit, or b) propose a pilot with capped tokens + credit to demonstrate parity.

Attached: BrightLayer_TCO_comparison.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30-min call Friday morning PT to walk through options?

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment: BrightLayer_TCO_comparison.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@brightlayer.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor swap pricing & packaging — alignment needed

Neha,

Thanks — I reviewed the TCO doc. Appreciate the clarity. Our incumbent (Acme Inc.) came back with a discounted list that undercuts your list by ~18% on model inference unit pricing. They also quoted a 90-day ramp pilot with a reduced rate.

Two constraints from procurement:
- We can’t exceed $1.6M YoY for inference licenses unless we get executive approval
- We need a standard SOC 2 + annual data processing addendum in the contract

I’m attaching the Acme quote for reference.

Would Redwood be open to a price match + equivalent pilot (90 days) to make this a like-for-like evaluation? If not, can you detail the technical/operational offsets that justify a higher rate?

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of AI Platforms, BrightLayer
emma.jones@brightlayer.com

--
Attachment: vendor_quote_acme-inc.pdf (PDF, 64KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor swap pricing & packaging — alignment needed

Emma — appreciate the transparency and the incumbent quote. Looping in Rishi (Sales Lead) and Marissa (Solutions) to align on packaging. Quick thoughts:

Options we can propose quickly for brightness:
1) Commitment match: 12-month Dedicated commit at a blended rate that approximates Acme’s discounted unit price. Requires: 12-month commit, standard SLA, and acceptance of Redwood Standard Terms + DPA (we can add SOC 2 attestation).
2) Pilot + conversion: 90-day capped pilot at a favorable pilot rate (smaller credit applied to first invoice if you convert). This minimizes upfront spend but limits long-term unit visibility.
3) Hybrid: 6-month pilot + optional conversion window to a 12-month commit with pre-agreed conversion pricing.

For commercial parity we’ll need clarity on: token assumptions, concurrent inference throughput requirements, and retention limits for logs. Marissa — can you confirm the engineering guardrails we should require from the pilot (metrics collection, uptime SLO for pilot, allowed traffic patterns)?

If you’re free Monday ET, we can run a 30-min alignment and I’ll bring a short MAP doc to capture milestones.

Best,
Neha

--
Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (DOCX, 24KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor swap pricing & packaging — alignment needed

Emma — thanks for the quote. I reviewed Acme’s terms and compared line-by-line with our commercial model. Short version: we can get within ~5% of their discounted unit economics if BrightLayer is willing to commit to the following (conditional price-match):

- 12-month Dedicated commitment (min monthly throughput/units defined in contract)
- 14-day payment terms, one-time onboarding fee waived with signature within 10 business days
- Standard DPA + SOC 2 evidence (we’ll provide report within 5 business days of signature)
- No unlimited burst without agreed overage policy (bursts will be metered)

Key tradeoffs / value adds vs incumbent:
• Lower tail latency for long-context workloads (real benchmarks available)
• Built-in prefix KV caching reduces per-token for repetitive prompts
• Transparent token-level billing in the Console (helps your chargeback)

Attached: RFP_vendor_answers.pdf (detailed answers to procurement RFP).

If BrightLayer can agree to the commit above we’ll issue a conditional price-match term sheet and circulate a DocuSign for the MAP + SOW. Otherwise, we recommend the 90-day pilot with a conversion credit to demonstrate value.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

--

> Emma — thanks for the quote. I reviewed Acme’s terms and compared line-by-line with our commercial model. Short version: we can get within ~5% of their discounted unit economics if BrightLayer is willing to commit to the following (conditional price-match):
> 
> - 12-month Dedicated commitment (min monthly throughput/units defined in contract)
> - 14-day payment terms, one-time onboarding fee waived with signature within 10 business days
> - Standard DPA + SOC 2 evidence (we’ll provide report within 5 business days of signature)

Rishi / Neha — appreciate the fast turn. A few follow-ups from procurement: 

1) The finance team is pushing back on 14-day terms — they need 30 days. Can you extend?
2) The 12-month commitment is heavy; they would consider 9 months at a slightly higher blended rate. What delta would that be?
3) We still need a clear description of what’s included in the pilot telemetry (retention windows & log export formats).

If we can get 30-day terms and a pricing delta for a 9-month commit, we can escalate to our CFO and legal this week. Prefer a short call tomorrow to finalize if possible.

Thanks,
Emma

Emma — quick update and proposed next steps:

1) Payment terms: we can extend to 30 days for the MAP/SOW (accepted).
2) Commitment length: 9-month Dedicated commit — we can offer a 3% premium on the 12-month matched unit price (i.e., price = matched_price * 1.03). We’ll put the exact blended units in the SOW.
3) Pilot telemetry: Marissa — please see the pilot telemetry note below for formal language (retention, export formats, SFTP delivery).

We’ll send a conditional term sheet + DocuSign link for the MAP and pilot SOW by EOD. If BrightLayer signs, we’ll schedule onboarding and SOC 2 evidence delivery timeline.

Internal note to Rishi / Marissa: once doc is out, can we pre-authorize the 3% delta and waive onboarding for this account? Need your quick OK so legal can turn in the first draft.

Thanks — Neha
